samuel1.2.p1.b1.text: My heart rejoices in the LORD in whom my horn is exalted.

samuel1.2.p1.b2.text: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.

samuel1.2.p1.b3.text: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.

samuel1.2.p1.b4.text: The well-fed hire themselves out for food, but the starving hunger no more. The barren woman gives birth to seven …

samuel1.2.p2.b1.text: The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.

samuel1.2.p2.b2.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap.

samuel1.2.p2.b3.text: He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor.

samuel1.2.p2.b4.text: … and will give power to His king. He will exalt the horn of His anointed.

samuel1.2.p3.b1.text: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy began ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest.

samuel1.2.p3.b2.text: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men; they had no regard for the LORD

samuel1.2.p3.b3.text: … the servant of the priest would come with a three-pronged meat fork while the meat was boiling and plunge it into the pan or kettle or cauldron or cooking pot. And the priest would claim for himself whatever the meat fork brought up.

samuel1.2.p4.b1.text: Give the priest some meat to roast, because he will not accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.

samuel1.2.p4.b2.text: The fat must be burned first; then you may take whatever you want

samuel1.2.p4.b3.text: No, you must give it to me right now. If you refuse, I will take it by force!

samuel1.2.p4.b4.text: Thus the sin of these young men was severe in the sight of the LORD, for they were treating the LORD’s offering with contempt.

samuel1.2.p5.b1.text: Now Samuel was ministering before the LORD—a boy wearing a linen ephod.

samuel1.2.p5.b2.text: Each year his mother would make him a little robe and bring it to him when she went with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

samuel1.2.p5.b3.text: May the LORD give you children by this woman in place of the one she dedicated to the LORD.

samuel1.2.p5.b4.text: So the LORD attended to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters.

samuel1.2.p6.b1.text: Now Eli was very old, and he heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel …

samuel1.2.p6.b2.text: No, my sons; it is not a good report I hear circulating among the LORD’s people.

samuel1.2.p6.b3.text: If a man sins against another man, God can intercede for him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who can intercede for him?

samuel1.2.p6.b4.text: But they would not listen to their father, since the LORD intended to put them to death.

samuel1.2.p6.b5.text: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with man.

samuel1.2.p7.b1.text: Then a man of God came to Eli and told him

samuel1.2.p7.b2.text: This is what the LORD says: Did I not clearly reveal Myself to your father’s house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh’s house? …

samuel1.2.p7.b3.text: … You have honored your sons more than Me by fattening yourselves with the best of all the offerings of My people Israel.

samuel1.2.p7.b4.text: For I will honor those who honor Me, but those who despise Me will be disdained.

samuel1.2.p8.b1.text: Behold, the days are coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your father’s house, so that no older man will be left in your house.

samuel1.2.p8.b2.text: … You will see distress in My dwelling place. Despite all that is good in Israel, no one in your house will ever again reach old age.

samuel1.2.p8.b3.text: … All your descendants will die by the sword of men.

samuel1.2.p9.b1.text: And this sign shall come to you concerning your two sons Hophni and Phinehas: They will both die on the same day.

samuel1.2.p9.b2.text: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest. He will do whatever is in My heart and mind.

samuel1.2.p9.b3.text: … for a piece of silver or a morsel of bread …
